inlines.v: UNGOD'LY, adjective 1. Wicked; impious; neglecting the fear and worship of God, or violating his commands. 1 Peter 4:18. 2. Sinful; contrary to the divine commands; as ungodly deeds. Jude 1:4. 3. Polluted by wickedness; as an ungodly day.
